A '''caravan''' of [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]] operated in the [[wasteland]]s of the largely uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Prine]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Led by a [[Unidentified pirate captain (Prine)|member]] of a four-horned species, the organization's members largely consisted of a pachydermoid species, and used long-necked reptilians as mounts and beasts of burden. In addition to salvage, the group worked in the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] trade, transporting their cargo in barges pulled by large, horned beasts.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], four months after the reorganization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into the Empire, these enslavers raided a [[Maddie's village|village]] on Prine, killing a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Yan]] and capturing his younger sister, [[Maddie]]. Later, they captured [[Ember Chankeli]], who had been stranded in the wasteland for two weeks after crash-landing there with a fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Dass Jennir]]. Chhankeli ran toward the a camp used by the enslavers willingly, not realizing the danger, and was quickly subdued.

[[File:Dass_Jennir_vs_raiders_on_Prine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The enslavers are attacked by fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]].]]

Jennir, followed by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[H2]], followed the raiders on a [[Unidentified bovid species|native bovine]] he had tamed with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When he caught up with them, he [[Skirmish on Prine|attacked]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], killing any who stood in his way. The rest either fled or were killed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Falco Sang]], who was attempting to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Jennir. Few escaped the battle, though the subsequent conflict between Jennir and Sang allowed others to flee. Sang eventually allowed the surviving enslavers to walk away on the condition that they would leave their barges and cargo behind.
